mapper.select: select * from clickcollect where userid=#{userid} and postid=#{postid}
mapper.update: update clickcollect set clickstatus= clickstatus+#{clickstatus} ,clicktime=curdate() where userid=#{userid} and postid=#{postid}
update clickcollect set collectstatus=collectstatus+#{collectstatus} ,collecttime=curdate() where userid=#{userid} and postid=#{postid}
